details.publicNotes:
Found around active volcanoes, ferrous crabs spend their days filtering molten iron and other metals from magma flows and cooled lava rock. They manipulate their bodies' natural magnetism to propel themselves through magma channels. In their natural habitats, they are calm and docile creatures.

However, when the lava flow dries up or another nearby volcano erupts, ferrous crabs gather in massive swarms to migrate to a new home. Their instinct to find the freshest molten rock drives them to incredible feats of endurance and persistence.

Ferrous crabs require a tremendous amount of metal and energy to survive their migrations. Often driven by starvation, they attempt to devour any metal they come across, regardless of whether that metal is attached to another living creature or not. In large numbers, their collective ability to adjust magnetism makes them particularly dangerous to creatures wearing metal armor or wielding metal weapons.

The devastation these little creatures can cause is legendary among the communities they migrate through. Many have developed an early warning system to either flee from the oncoming swarms or lay out trails of metal scraps to lure the crabs onto a different path.

Ore Finders

A ferrous crab's ability to sense nearby metal has encouraged some miners to track swarms of them to new lodes, though always from a healthy distance. Similarly, geomancers occasionally employ individual crabs to help them identify the location of ley lines or veins of unusual minerals. Devotees of earth or metal gods often feed the ferrous crabs that gather around their temples, sometimes as a benefaction to their deity but more often simply to keep the metal-hungry crustaceans at bay.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 12/27/50 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (bludgeoning), armor (heavy), shield, perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, burning barbs, constitution, energy resistant (fire, vitality), fire, fire shield, fortification, metal, sensory (darkvision), sturdy, wild, wisdom

description.value: Due to its innate magnetism, a ferrous crab swarm senses nearby chunks of metal of at least light Bulk.

Ferrous crabs attempt to devour metal objects. At the start of the crabs' turn, all unattended metal objects in their squares take @Damage[2d6[untyped]] damage, ignoring Hardness. Each creature in the swarm's space who is wearing or carrying a metal item must attempt at a @Check[reflex|dc:20] save; on a failure, the crabs deal @Damage[2d6[untyped]] damage to one of their metal items, ignoring Hardness.

Each enemy wearing metal armor in the swarm's space takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save). Each target that fails the saving throw is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until the end of its next turn.
Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning],1d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save).

The ferrous crab swarm makes a molten claw attack and then magnetizes their foes. Each enemy creature in the swarm's space that is carrying at least 1 Bulk of metal objects must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20] save with the following effects.

Critical Success The creature uses magnetic propulsion to their advantage. They can immediately Step.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature's ability to grasp metal items is hampered for 1 round. During that time, attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the target of metal items gain a +2 circumstance bonus, and the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attacks with metal item or other checks requiring a firm grasp on the item. Additionally, if the creature is wearing metal armor, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of their next turn.

Critical Failure Any metal object (including weapons) that the creature is holding drop from their hand and lands in the creature's space. Additionally, if the creature is wearing metal armor, they are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
